title: What Gig Economy Cooperatives Is
definition: Gig Economy Cooperatives: worker-owned gig platforms.
description:
Gig Economy Cooperatives: worker-owned gig platforms. This is Future Education & Work at its most ambitious — coop apps research, cooperative logistics engineering and rate floors operations converging on a single goal: making cooperative hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Education & Work will decide member dividends outcomes this century. Gig Economy Cooperatives is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working cooperative hulls, the larger coop apps vision stalls, and with it, the cooperative logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Gig Economy Cooperatives in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Gig Economy Cooperatives
title: Real Research Today: Gig Economy Cooperatives
definition: Today's documented research behind Gig Economy Cooperatives.
description:
The road to Gig Economy Cooperatives is already being paved. Khan Academy and its Khanmigo AI tutor bring personal tutoring to millions. The 4-day week trials (UK, Iceland, 4 Day Week Global) show maintained output with less time.

Maker education (FabLearn, fab labs) puts fabrication tools in thousands of schools. Together these programs form the coop apps foundation that Gig Economy Cooperatives will build on — the cooperative logistics results, the rate floors methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as cooperative logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: 2030 — First cooperative hulls networks graduate 100
definition: 2030 milestone on the Gig Economy Cooperatives roadmap.
description:
First cooperative hulls networks graduate 100,000 learners with rate floors credentials employers trust.

What must be true first: the coop apps results have to replicate outside the lab, cooperative logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and rate floors operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed coop apps demonstrations, cooperative logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting rate floors uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Gig Economy Cooperatives
definition: Estimates Gig Economy Cooperatives readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Gig Economy Cooperatives components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cooperative hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Gig Economy Cooperatives Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Gig Economy Cooperatives operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Gig Economy Cooperatives installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 31591 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where coop apps monitoring, cooperative logistics redundancy, or rate floors maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Gig Economy Cooperatives Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Gig Economy Cooperatives: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Gig Economy Cooperatives — worker-owned gig platforms.

Phase 1 — Prove (coop apps): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cooperative logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rate floors): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (member dividends): cooperative hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and gig workers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
